set.body: Goal: typed position adjustments applied after stats and before geom lowering: dodge and stack for grouped geoms, deterministic seeded jitter for points. Acceptance: Position enum on Layer with a dedicated compiler step; group-aware interaction with GeomPhase; deterministic across JVM/JS (no Math.random); tests cover dodged/stacked counts and seeded jitter reproducibility.
set.title: Graphics: position adjustments (dodge, stack, jitter)
